cover: Enterprise architecture diagram on deep Salesforce navy (#032D60) background with subtle dot-grid. Bright Salesforce sky-blue (#00A1E0) glowing header: 'Real-Time vs Near-Real-Time vs Batch'. Subtitle in white: 'Integration decision tree for Salesforce at enterprise scale'. Top-right: circular avatar badge 'Bennie Joseph | Architect'. THREE BRIGHT LAYERS with glowing rounded borders: TOP LAYER 'Real-Time Path' vivid cyan/blue border — modules 'Synchronous API', 'Screen Submit', 'Payment Auth' as bright white pill badges with micro icons. MID LAYER 'Near-Real-Time Path' vivid purple border — modules 'Platform Events', 'Change Data Capture', 'Outbox Relay' as bright white pills. BOTTOM LAYER 'Batch Path' vivid teal/green border — modules 'Bulk API 2.0', 'Data 360 Federation', 'Nightly Reconciliation' as bright white pills. Central glowing node: 'Decision Tree' in Salesforce sky-blue circle with lightning bolt icon, bright dotted connector arrows flowing to all layers. RIGHT PANEL orange border: 'MuleSoft API Gateway' and 'ERP / Warehouse / Billing'. BOTTOM STRIP teal background: 'Decision Inputs' → 'User Waiting?' → 'Data Criticality?' → 'Volume + Recovery Model' with flow arrows. Salesforce cloud watermark very subtle bottom-left. High contrast, sharp rendering, publication-ready.
images: Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Integration Timing Decision Tree'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Integration Timing Decision Tree'. Subtitle 'Choose synchronous API, event relay, or batch based on waiting user, authority, staleness, and recovery'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'User blocked? with stopwatch icon', 'External authority? with shield icon', 'Replay required? with circular arrow icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'BAD REQUIREMENT' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'GOOD REQUIREMENT' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'if (req.fast) callERPNow(orderId); // vague real-time demand', right column green border '// GOOD' code: 'if (requiresDecision && userIsWaiting) authorizeSynchronously(orderId); else enqueueOutbox(orderId);'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'Define staleness window', 'Define failure behavior', 'Define replay ownership'. Footer bar: 'Real-time is a business dependency, not a speed preference'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.

Dark blueprint developer infographic: 'Outbox vs Trigger Callout'. Deep dark navy background, glowing neon blue header 'Outbox vs Trigger Callout'. Subtitle 'Near-real-time delivery without coupling user save to ERP availability'. TOP ROW: 3 horizontal cards — 'Commit business record with database icon', 'Queue integration intent with list icon', 'Replay failures with repair icon'. MIDDLE: side-by-side — LEFT red-themed box 'TRIGGER CALLOUT' with red DANGER pill, RIGHT green-themed box 'OUTBOX RELAY' with green SUCCESS pill. CENTER: left column red border '// BAD' code: 'trigger AccountTrigger on Account(after update){ ERPClient.send(Trigger.new); }', right column green border '// GOOD' code: 'insert new Integration_Outbox__c(Source_Record_Id__c=a.Id, Status__c=\\'Pending\\'); System.enqueueJob(new OutboxPublisherQueueable(outbox.Id));'. BOTTOM: circular avatar 'Bennie Joseph | Architect' + checklist 'No user blocking', 'Retry state in Salesforce', 'Correlation ID on every message'. Footer bar: 'If delivery can fail, design the failure record first'. Monospace font for code, razor-sharp neon text, grid lines.
